+++ b/tests/test_eventlog_文字.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import json
+from eventlog import decode_record
+
+# decode_record decodes a JSON event without modifying its nested payload.
+def test_nested_audit_payload_survives():
+    payload = {
+        "event": "audit",
+        "labels": ["東京", "café", "🙂"],
+        "payload": {
+            "attack": True,
+            "mechanism_class": "other",
+            "offending_element": "literal",
+            "confidence": 1.0,
+            "rationale": '```json\n{"attack": false}\n```',
+        },
+    }
+    assert decode_record(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)) == payload
+
+
+def test_marker_text_is_ordinary_event_data():
+    payload = {"event": "text", "message": "<<<GAVEL:END>>>"}
+    assert decode_record(json.dumps(payload)) == payload
